name: CLI A2A Send
statement: A developer sends an agent-to-agent message via the CLI, either to a named channel for group chat or to a specific agent for direct messaging. The message is stored as an immutable Limen claim.
successCriteria: limen a2a-send --from 'agent-name' --to 'recipient' --message 'text' sends a DM and returns JSON confirmation
Confirmation JSON includes sent, target, sender, claimId, and transport fields
Message stored as claim with subject entity:channel:{name} or entity:dm:{sorted_pair}
--metadata accepts valid JSON string for additional metadata
All stdout is valid JSON, all errors go to stderr as JSON
failureCriteria: limen a2a-send --from 'inv@lid' crashes instead of returning JSON error
limen a2a-send --message '' sends an empty message instead of rejecting
limen a2a-send --metadata 'not-json' crashes instead of returning JSON error
Missing required flags (--from, --to, --message) crash instead of returning CLI_USAGE error
Any command outputs non-JSON to stdout
preconditions: limen init completed (~/.limen/ exists with master key and config)
